name: AutoTorch!
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Nikrecs
description: A client-side mod that automatically places torches at your feet when it gets dark. Fully configurable and pulls directly from your inventory!

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Places a torch at your feet from the inventory when the light gets low; client command /autotorchset.
note: Not yet: Its settings screen and /autotorchset aren't checked.
